column1: # 客户端发给服务端的命令包：包号 → 我们自己的话写的标签与长度（处理函数实际校验的；var = 变长，? = 未知）。c2s.py 读它。
# 命令包 cmd 走 main+0x6e5b40 的处理表（main+0x20a4190），每个处理函数自己校验长度；系统类消息 sys 走 main+0x6310b0（见 command_packet_format.md）。
# Client-to-server command packets: number -> label in our own words and length (as the handler checks it; var = variable, ? = unknown). Read by c2s.py.

# Command packets (cmd) go through the handler table of main+0x6e5b40 (main+0x20a4190), each handler checking its own length; system-class messages (sys) go through main+0x6310b0 (see command_packet_format.md).
